DialogueContent: Oh! I didn't notice you there—Greetings!
I'm Shikkor, an explorer, or at least I was once... Though this place is stranger than any realm I've encountered.
The presence of hostile creatures here is... troubling.
You appear quite capable. Might you lend your strength to ensure I can safely continue my exploration?
I'll do my best.
Excellent! Perhaps I can offer assistance as well—I have an exceptional sense for navigation. Allow me to map this realm for you in return.
What should my first task be?
Relax.
Remarkable... this place feels secure. Is it within you?
Fascinating! Ah! That coffin of yours—quite extraordinary! It allows me to clearly see your surroundings.
Pardon my memory, but... your name was?
...Grim.
Grim, since entering here, I've felt my strength slowly returning.
If you could help me gather 500 <sprite index=0>, my abilities should significantly improve, allowing me to better assist you.
Remember to take a break every now and then.
It's you! You're the one who silenced me and trapped me in that coffin!
Hurry up and send me back—I refuse to waste another second out here.
Not a single moment outside the coffin has passed without endless running... endless, exhausting running!
But...
Enough hesitation! If you won't act, I'll do it myself. Let me help you move faster
...Alright.
Huh, not bad. Looks like you've upgraded your coffin—it wasn't this spacious before.
This isn't the same as before.
Tell me—why weren't we inside the coffin in the first place? Isn't this your responsibility?
I... I don't know.
Very well. Since you're clearly overwhelmed, I'll assist you. But now, I'm going to rest. I'll need plenty of energy for our training later.
What are you staring at? Never seen a champion prepare before?
Faster, faster, faster!
Hello?
Oh—hello, hello! I've been dying for an audience.
Care to witness my juggling skills? I'll guarantee laughter in no time!
Uh... sure?
Wonderful! Watch closely—this is my greatest routine yet!
...You know, it's alright to laugh...
Did I mess up? Wait—I can even teach you to juggle your scythe! Please stay for just one more act...
...Relax. I'll take you someplace with more spectators.
At least you've more audience here.
Indeed! A clown is nothing without spectators.
You've granted me this stage—now, I'll deliver the finest performance a clown can offer!
...I have tasks to complete...
Don't forget to bring back more audience!
Miss my show?
You're back. How's your head? Any pain or strange feelings?
I'm still weak.
I want to get stronger.
Expected as much. I sorted the herbs(<sprite index=1>)I've found while you were away. There's one that can strengthen you, though it won't restore you to full power.
I used the last of my supply to brew this potion for you. Drink up—but after this, you'll have to collect more on your own.
Bring me three of those herbs(<sprite index=1>), and I'll make you another batch.
Feeling better?
Glory! Death! Slaughter!
Well done, boy. You're about two percent of what I was.
But your moves are still too rigid, and you don't know how to improvise.
Can you teach me?
Oh! Of course! There's nothing I like more than training eager apprentices!
Find a place! I'll teach you some skills..
A splendid spot! I can already feel my muscles and joints loosening up.
Alright, first lesson: as a warrior, agility is key. You must learn to strike your enemies swiftly and unpredictably.
Sometimes, redirecting your attack can accomplish more than merely killing your opponent.
Your current style of fighting is far too repetitive. Bring me 1000<sprite index=0>, and I'll show you some advanced techniques.
Don't let up!
